visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is divided into a horizontal split-screen composition. In the top half, a large orchestra is positioned on an outdoor stage with stadium seating and green hills visible in the background. A conductor in a dark suit leads musicians playing violins and drums. In the bottom half, a young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun with a butterfly accessory is seen in a medium shot. She wears a white haori with a distinctive pink and black butterfly wing pattern over a black uniform, holding a silver transverse flute. (2) The performer plays the flute with focused eyes and rapid finger movements. She sways her torso rhythmically. A woman in a black jacket stands to the performer's right, partially visible. Behind the performer is a large graphic of a character with a boar's head. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional stage setup. (3) As the performance ends, the woman lowers her flute and smiles warmly toward the camera. Colorful paper streamers and confetti explode from the top of the frame and fall across the scene. The orchestra members in the top panel are seen concluding their playing. The woman performs a slight bow as the camera remains steady.
